title: Nonlinear maps and tangential cone control

items.title: Nonlinear forward maps between Hilbert spaces

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, Chapter 9
Barbara Kaltenbacher, Frank Schöpfer, and Thomas Schuster, Iterative methods for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach spaces, §1

items.statement:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be real Hilbert spaces and let $U\subseteq X$ be a nonempty open set in the norm topology. A **nonlinear forward model on Hilbert spaces** is a map $F:U\to Y$; no linearity is assumed, and linear maps are allowed as special cases. For $y\in Y$, its exact solution set is

$$S_F(y):=\{x\in U:F(x)=y\}.$$

A point $x^\dagger\in U$ generates the exact datum $y=F(x^\dagger)$. When $F$ is Fréchet differentiable at $x\in U$, write $F'(x):X\to Y$ for its unique bounded real-linear derivative.

items.title: x₀-minimum-norm solutions of nonlinear equations

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, Theorem 9.9
Barbara Kaltenbacher, Frank Schöpfer, and Thomas Schuster, Iterative methods for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach spaces, Proposition 1

items.statement:
Let $X,Y$ be real Hilbert spaces, let $U\subseteq X$ be a nonempty open set, let $F:U\to Y$ be a forward map, let $y\in Y$, and let $x_0\in X$. A point $x^\dagger\in U$ is an **$x_0$-minimum-norm solution** of $F(x)=y$ on $U$ if $F(x^\dagger)=y$ and

$$\|x^\dagger-x_0\|\le\|x-x_0\|\qquad\text{for every }x\in U\text{ with }F(x)=y.$$

This definition asserts no existence or uniqueness; it describes the minimizing property of a supplied exact solution. The minimum is global over the exact solution set on $U$, with distance measured from the specified reference point $x_0$.

items.title: Local tangential cone condition

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, equation (9.6)
Barbara Kaltenbacher, Frank Schöpfer, and Thomas Schuster, Iterative methods for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach spaces, §2.3

items.statement:
Let $X,Y$ be real Hilbert spaces, let $U\subseteq X$ be open, and let $F:U\to Y$ be Fréchet differentiable at $x\in U$. For $\delta>0$ such that the closed ball

$$\overline B_\delta(x):=\{x+h:h\in X,\ \|h\|_X\le\delta\}$$

is contained in $U$, the **local tangential cone condition at $x$ on radius $\delta$ with constant $\eta$** holds if $0\le\eta<1$ and

$$\|F(x+h)-F(x)-F'(x)h\|_Y\le\eta\,\|F(x+h)-F(x)\|_Y\qquad(\|h\|_X\le\delta).$$

items.title: Tangential cone control compares derivative and data residuals

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, Theorem 9.8
Barbara Kaltenbacher, Frank Schöpfer, and Thomas Schuster, Iterative methods for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach spaces, §2.3

items.statement:
Let $X,Y$ be real Hilbert spaces, let $U\subseteq X$ be open, and let $F:U\to Y$ be Fréchet differentiable at $x\in U$. Suppose that for some $\delta>0$ with $\overline B_\delta(x)\subseteq U$ and some $0\le\eta<1$, the local tangential cone condition at $x$ holds on radius $\delta$ with constant $\eta$. Then for every $h\in X$ with $\|h\|_X\le\delta$,

$$
(1-\eta)\,\|F(x+h)-F(x)\|_Y\le\|F'(x)h\|_Y\le(1+\eta)\,\|F(x+h)-F(x)\|_Y.
$$

items.title: Local uniqueness of an x₀-minimum-norm solution under TCC

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, Theorem 9.9
Barbara Kaltenbacher, Frank Schöpfer, and Thomas Schuster, Iterative methods for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach spaces, Proposition 1

items.statement:
Let $X,Y$ be real Hilbert spaces, let $U\subseteq X$ be open, and let $F:U\to Y$ be Fréchet differentiable. Let $x_0\in X$, $y\in Y$, and let $x^\dagger\in U$ be an $x_0$-minimum-norm solution of $F(x)=y$ on $U$. Suppose that for some $\delta>0$ the closed ball $\overline B_\delta(x^\dagger)$ lies in $U$, the local tangential cone condition holds at $x^\dagger$ on radius $\delta$ with a constant $0\le\eta<1$, and

$$x^\dagger-x_0\in\ker(F'(x^\dagger))^\perp.$$

Then every $x\in\overline B_\delta(x^\dagger)$ with $F(x)=y$ and $x\ne x^\dagger$ satisfies

$$\|x-x_0\|_X>\|x^\dagger-x_0\|_X.$$

Consequently, $x^\dagger$ is the unique $x_0$-minimum-norm solution among the exact solutions in $\overline B_\delta(x^\dagger)$.

title: Nonlinear maps and tangential cone control — Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: A smooth map can fail the tangential cone condition

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, equation (9.6) and Theorem 9.9

items.statement: Every infinitely differentiable forward map between real Hilbert spaces satisfies a local tangential cone condition at each point of its domain with some radius $\delta>0$ and some constant $0\le\eta<1$.

items.title: A smooth map with a local tangential cone neighborhood

references.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems, equation (9.6)

items.statement: Let $X=Y=\mathbb R$ with their usual real Hilbert structure, let $U=\mathbb R$, and define the smooth forward map $F(t)=t+t^2$. At $x^\dagger=1$ the exact datum is $y=F(1)=2$. The local tangential cone condition holds at $1$ on the closed ball of radius $\delta=1/4$ with constant $\eta=1/10$.
